messages:
leo-fin: Heads-up: customer ops flagged a spike in token billing for streaming requests from three customers yesterday. Looks like overcounting.

mira-eng: saw the alert. initial dig shows duplicate ACKs from the public gateway causing the same chunk to be logged twice into the token ledger.

ben-gateway: repro snippet from gateway logs: `2024-08-12T21:03:12Z INFO chunk_sent id=abc123 seq=12` followed by `2024-08-12T21:03:12Z WARN ack_retry id=abc123 seq=12 sent_again=true`. downstream ingestion then wrote two token events for seq=12.

leo-fin: customers impacted: DatumCorp (acct_110), Helios Labs (acct_221), OrbitData (acct_332). Preliminary overcount: DatumCorp +1.1M tokens, Helios +830k, Orbit +540k. Rough overcharge ~ $4,900.

billing-bot: Automated anomaly: token_count_delta > 1e6 for acct_110. Created ticket INC-3001.

toni-infra: root cause appears to be a gateway retry loop with a missing idempotency key header for streaming chunks. The retry policy treats chunk acks as different requests. Patch ready to add idempotency header and dedupe in ingest.

mira-eng: mitigation plan: 1) deploy dedupe middleware to ingest service (checks request_id + chunk_seq) 2) add idempotency header on gateway retries 3) run a dedupe replay to collapse duplicate token events.

sam-sales: DatumCorp noticed the spike and is unhappy. We should proactively credit them while we fix it.

leo-fin: request: finance approval for provisional credits to the three accounts to prevent disputes while we run the dedupe and reconcile. Proposed provisional total $4,900 allocated proportionally.

oli-finance: Approved provisional credit of $4,900. Please annotate invoices: "Provisional credit issued pending ledger dedupe and verification." Billing ops to apply adjustments and keep audit traces.

ben-gateway: deploying idempotency header to canary now (commit: gateway@b7f9a1). Will monitor for new duplicate events.

toni-infra: kickstarting dedupe replay job: job id dedupe-2067890123. Steps: 1) aggregate token_events by (request_id, chunk_seq) 2) collapse duplicates keeping earliest event_id 3) produce CSV with account_id, org_name, original_tokens, deduped_tokens, token_delta. Upload to s3://redwood-billing/replays/2067890123-dedupe.csv

mira-eng: SQL used for diff (for reference): `WITH grouped AS (SELECT request_id, chunk_seq, count(*) as cnt, sum(tokens) as tokens FROM token_events WHERE created_at >= '2024-08-12' AND created_at < '2024-08-13' GROUP BY request_id, chunk_seq) SELECT account_id, sum(cnt-1) as dup_hits, sum(tokens) as total_tokens FROM token_events JOIN grouped USING (request_id, chunk_seq) WHERE grouped.cnt > 1 GROUP BY account_id;`

billing-bot: Dedupe job queued: dedupe-2067890123. Will post completion when finished.

ben-gateway: canary looks good; no new duplicates after idempotency header applied.

toni-infra: dedupe job completed. Uploaded diff: s3://redwood-billing/replays/2067890123-dedupe.csv. Report summary: DatumCorp delta -1,098,732 tokens, Helios -829,405, Orbit -539,620.

leo-fin: received diff. billing ops: please ingest CSV and apply provisional adjustments. Finance will reconcile next billing cycle and either re-invoice or reverse credits if needed. Attach audit logs to INC-3001.

sam-sales: i'll send DatumCorp a short note: "We've issued a provisional credit for the token spike while we verify and fix our ingestion. We'll follow up with final reconciliation."

mira-eng: leaving monitoring in place for 24h and will open a postmortem detailing root cause and mitigation timeline.
